policy: Separate 0.3.0 additions only. Preserve the completed 438-industry candidate. A named mining/smelting district is not a claim that the proxy layout represents an individual historic building. Ancillary quarries, salteries, livestock and ports are explicitly regional chain representations.
records: Allihies Duneen copper workings, active from 1812
Hafod Swansea Welsh-process copper works, active from 1810
Lower Swansea valley ancillary mineral supply proxy
Swansea copper export and supply harbour representation
Krakow regional salted meat trade representation
Bochnia regional livestock and curing representation
Aveiro regional fish salting and export representation
limitations: No tin cargo is invented for Cornwall.
Copper exports terminate at the existing wharf. This is an abstract international metal market, not a fictitious copper-to-food conversion.
Slag is a waste by-product in 1830. The 1945 slag-grinding plant is not backdated. No artificial 1830 slag consumer is added.

Regional salteries are representative trades, not independently verified named factory addresses. The Scottish curing source supports the trade, not every listed town or the abstract conversion ratio.
Falun remains outside the map. No northern mine is relocated southwards.
Coastal evaporator placement depends on the unchanged AXIS layout and coast rules. Failed placements must be reported, not forced by terraforming.
